notes.title: New Price for Aurora!
notes.content: To help celebrate the release of Pixel Game Maker MV next Tuesday and two more projects shaping up, I am thrilled to announce that I am permanently lowering the price of Aurora to $1.99 (and similar prices globally). I hope to increase the number of people I can reach across the globe and I am very excited to have two more projects that will be released sometime in 2018! Please be sure to check out my new website (and Aurora's new home) at http://www.nicholasturnergames.win to keep up with me and my games as I will be releasing all the details there first about my new projects! Thank you and happy gaming!

notes.title: Aurora on sale now!
notes.content:
Aurora released yesterday, March 2nd, 2018 and to celebrate its release, Aurora will be on sale until March 9th, 2018 with a 33% off discount!

I am excited to hear about your adventures in the world of Wenryll and look forward to reading your feedback! Please reach out to me with your questions, comments or concerns!
